name: iete-sf-chatbot
description: Intelligent client-side chatbot for IETE-SF SVKM's NMIMS MPSTME official website

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'/chat.html':req.url;let p=path.join(__dirname,f);if(fs.existsSync(p)){let ct=f.endsWith('.js')?'application/javascript':f.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':'text/html';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct});res.end(fs.readFileSync(p))}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found')}}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('⚡ Server running at http://localhost:3000/chat.html'))"

author: IETE-SF Technical Team
